== Missing data ==
Encyclopedia 2.0 names Decipher employee promotional appearances, the Scrye #18 insert, mail-away requests, and the First Anthology as how players received a pack. Encyclopedia 3.2 names the Scrye #18 insert and the First Anthology. The sealed bag is printed "FREE JEDI PACK" and "ONE PER CUSTOMER... PLEASE". The bag also prints "ALL JEDI PACKS CONTAIN THE SAME 11 COMMON CARDS"; the card list uses Premium.

Wookieepedia and hobby listings add a SASE shipping fee. That wording is not dested. CardGuide's 10-card count is not dested.

== Possibly faulty data: release date ==

Decipher's product history labels Jedi Packs as an October 1996 product. The collecting catalog dates the promotional packs to April 1996. The infobox and lead now follow the original publisher's month, and the catalog remains the source for the eleven-card contents and distribution history. The competing April date is retained here.<ref name="decipher-date">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="collecting-date">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 4, 33 and 35. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
